subject: Quick recap — where inference sits in your roadmap?
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Kate Morris <kate@brightmove.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap — where inference sits in your roadmap?

Hi Kate,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — appreciate the clarity on BrightMove's immediate goals. Short recap from our call and two quick asks: 

Call recap:
- Goal: move from prototype to production for resume-parsing inference (1–2M tokens/day peak).
- Primary constraints: sub-200ms 95th p99 latency for short batches, and strict PII handling in transit.
- Internal owners: Data team (you) + Platform (procurement loop briefly mentioned).

Suggested next steps:
1) Would you classify this as a near-term priority (pilot in Q4) or something for next quarter?
2) If pilot is realistic, would a 4–6 week technical pilot with a single model variant and a dedicated endpoint match your needs?
3) If yes to (2), are there any procurement or security items we should prepare now (SOC 2 evidence, KMS notes, network diagram)?

I attached a 2-page quickstart that covers a typical pilot topology and expected token economics for the workload (redwood-quickstart.pdf). Also linking the short demo recording and the HubSpot deal for your reference.

No pressure — just trying to align on whether we should set a technical sync next week or hold for a later window. If helpful, Ben (cc'd) can join for the infra/ops details.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

Attachment: redwood-quickstart.pdf

Hi Kate — just bumping this in case it got buried.

Short options if it helps move things forward:
- 20 min tech sync with Ben and me (agenda: pilot topology + security checklist)
- We can also send a concise procurement packet (SOC 2 excerpt + network diagram + pilot SOW) if that's easier for your team to circulate.

Are you leaning toward a Q4 pilot or should we pause outreach for now? A one-line update is totally fine.

Thanks — Hannah

Hi Hannah — sorry for the slow reply, we've been closing out a separate vendor evaluation this week. Quick update:

- The Data team still sees potential fit for a pilot, but procurement is picking up the cadence (cc'd).
- Before we commit a calendar slot, procurement asked for rough pilot pricing and an expected resource profile (GPUs, dedicated endpoint, estimated monthly tokens). Can you send a short ballpark so they can model the pilot cost?

If you can share that in the next couple of days, procurement will determine whether we can move forward with a tech sync. Otherwise we may need to circle back next month.

Thanks — Kate
